==Description==
The '''Blighted''' was an enemy that used to have high health and average speed. It had more health and was slightly faster than the [[Slow Boss]], making the '''Blighted''' a very dangerous enemy if not prepared for. When added, the '''Blighted''' used to be spawned by the [[Necromancer 2]], though this was removed shortly after its addition.

The '''Blighted''' no longer appears in the game. It has since been replaced (appearance-wise) with the [[Heavy]].

== Appearance ==
The '''Blighted''' was a normal-sized enemy with grey skin, a light green granite torso and dark green granite legs. It had a drooling zombie face. The '''Blighted''' also emitted green and dark green particles from its torso.

== Strategy ==
*The [[Ranger|Outlaw]], [[Minigunner]] and [[Turret]] are able to deal with the '''Blighted''' very well due to their high DPS.
**Additionally, you should use the [[Commander]] to boost these towers' firerate.
*As '''Blighteds''' typically spawn in hordes, a few [[Rocketeer|Rocketers]] should fare well against them.

== Trivia ==
*When they were initially added, '''Blighteds''' and [[Necromancer 2]]s were considered to be the most dangerous enemies in the game due to the sheer amount of health they had.
**They were later nerfed as they were deemed too difficult to defeat.
*'''Blighteds''' could have gotten stuck on corners and would not move forward if the [[Necromancer 2]] that spawned them died.
